name: html-app
description: Build elaborate, self-contained single-file HTML app artifacts for claude.ai using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui. Scaffolds a Vite project with 56 pre-installed components, then bundles everything (JS, CSS, assets) into one inlined HTML file. Use for complex artifacts needing state, routing, or shadcn/ui — not for trivial single-file HTML/JSX.
